info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Linarite Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Linarite Produce Detail Catalog API facilitates the creation of detailed product entries for Linarite produce within the catalog system. This API allows businesses to enhance their product offerings by submitting specific information about Linarite produce items. Users can expect to manage product descriptions, attributes, and availability seamlessly. Typical consumers of this API include agricultural suppliers and ecommerce platforms looking to enrich their catalog with detailed product data.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details related to Linarite produce. It facilitates the entry of specific information to enhance the tracking and management of Linarite produce.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details for the Linarite production operations. It should include all necessary parameters in JSON format, adhering to the specified schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the details have been retrieved.
